details: Bitcoin surged past $86,000, pushing the total cryptocurrency market capitalization above $3 trillion. This rally is significantly driven by strong institutional demand, evidenced by nearly $1 billion in daily inflows into spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), marking the largest daily inflow in 11 months. Short liquidations also contributed to Bitcoin's momentum, with overall market sentiment moving into "Extreme Greed" at 78.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $86K, Crypto Market Cap Hits $3T on ETF Inflows

details: The Moscow Exchange (MOEX) has launched cash-settled Bitcoin perpetual futures, available to qualified investors. These contracts are priced in US dollars but settled in rubles, offering Russian investors a way to gain exposure to Bitcoin price movements amidst existing capital controls. The initial trading volume on the first day was $1.3 million.
title: Moscow Exchange Debuts Bitcoin Perpetual Futures

details: The proposed US CLARITY Act, a bill intended to provide regulatory clarity for digital assets, failed to advance in the Senate with a 49-50 vote. While this outcome means that comprehensive regulatory frameworks remain uncertain, it also removes an immediate legislative threat that could have imposed new restrictions. The market reaction saw some crypto shorts liquidated, contributing to broader market rebounds.
title: US CLARITY Act Fails in Senate, Regulatory Uncertainty Persists
